scope_selection: Before fitting v4 models; two repeated labels plus three illustrative existing labels with high hand visibility. No label chosen by v4 held-out metrics.
normalization: fit on training originals per fold only; no held-out augmentation
fold_unit: original source video, leave one original out only where that class remains in training
candidate: same TCN plus balanced-label batches, mild crop/time jitter and short synthetic hand dropout
default_model: tcn fixed before v4 metrics; candidates comparison only
comparison_to_v3: Different vocabulary and training set, not a direct claim of improvement over 34-label v3.
limitations: No blind test; retrospective existing videos
Five held-out source clips reused over three seeds; not fifteen independent clips
Reported macro F1 restricted to the two actually tested labels
Three singleton labels have no held-out test
